systems.system: Mandatory digital payment for a first wave of public service operations, including taxes and duties owed to the collectivités territoriales and fees for civil status acts, resting on mobile money services and digital platforms
systems.platform: mobile money services and digital platforms, unnamed
systems.owner: four ministries by interministerial instruction of 2024-07-19; operations listed by order of the finance minister
systems.tiers: state services, national public establishments and the collectivités territoriales; mayors and heads of special delegations named among those to implement it

note: The interministerial instruction of 2024-07-19 making digital payment mandatory for listed operations, some of them the local governments': a payment application, with nothing stated about how any local government office is connected.
